sources.classification: labelled from the task code, 2026-10-11; workload revised 2026-10-22: NeuMF (two user / item table pairs, the GMF branch multiplies one, the MLP branch concatenates the other), the NCF leaf `ncf_training` under `recsys_training`; precision fp16 (apex amp O2, as the rows' logs record: amp True); params = (138 493 users + 26 744 items) x (64 + 128) embedding weights + MLP and final layers = 31.83 M; dataset_samples = the samples the loop iterates per epoch: MovieLens-20M ratings minus one test rating per user (20 000 263 - 138 493 = 19 861 770 positives) plus 4 negatives per positive = 99 308 850

measurements.source: Lambda, github.com/lambdal/deeplearning-benchmark, commit aa5addb6 (2025-12-17), pytorch/pytorch-train-throughput-fp16.csv, column ncf (training throughput, samples/s), single-GPU rows of 48 GB cards, run with batch 10 000 000 under apex amp O2 (pytorch/pytorch-train-bs-fp16.csv; config_pytorch_48GB.sh, no ncf batch fix in the GPU configs): 'RTX 6000 Ada' 33148978; 'RTX A6000' 25357954; 'Quadro RTX 8000' 19801310; the logs of these rows (pytorch/results/AdaA6000_v1, A6000_v1, QuadroRTX8000_v1 / PyTorch_ncf_FP16) record amp True, opt_level O2. The 80 GB cards ran the same batch in fp32 and are a separate task, lambdalabs/ncf_ml20m_bs10m
